intents.description: Problems caused by iOS updates such as crashes, performance degradation, battery drain, and data loss.
intents.example_problem: After updating to iOS 11 my iPhone keeps crashing and apps freeze.
intents.mapping_reason: These clusters all contain complaints about iOS updates causing device instability.

intents.description: General frustration or ambiguous complaints not clearly tied to a specific product or issue.
intents.example_problem: I am frustrated with Apple support and the service.
intents.mapping_reason: Cluster 2 contains generic anger and unclear product issues.

intents.description: Hardware or software problems on MacBook devices, including crashes, connectivity, and performance.
intents.example_problem: My MacBook Pro keeps shutting down after updating to High Sierra.

intents.description: Keyboard or autocorrect glitches where letters (especially 'I') turn into question marks or other symbols.
intents.example_problem: The 'I' on my phone turns into a question mark box after the latest update.
intents.mapping_reason: Both clusters discuss the same keyboard autocorrect problem.

intents.description: Audio playback or Apple Music related problems, including sync, playback, and device connectivity.
intents.example_problem: Apple Music won't play my songs after the update.
intents.mapping_reason: Cluster 6 contains Apple Music and audio issues.

intents.description: Physical or functional problems with iPhones such as screen blackouts, app crashes, lost photos, and charging issues.
intents.example_problem: My iPhone 7 keeps rebooting and I lose all my photos.

intents.description: Issues with Apple ID, Apple Pay, iCloud, and account recovery.
intents.example_problem: I forgot my Apple ID password and can't reset it.
intents.mapping_reason: Cluster 8 focuses on account and identity problems.

intents.description: Battery drain or performance problems after updates or normal use.
intents.example_problem: My battery drains from 80% to 20% in 30 minutes after updating to iOS 11.
intents.mapping_reason: Cluster 11 specifically addresses battery life concerns.
